title: The ph Digraph
rule: The letters ph are a digraph: two letters, one sound, f. Underline both letters. You have to remember which words use ph, like phone and graph.
trickText: Hear the f sound. Is it spelled f, like fish, or ph, like phone? Underline ph when you see it.
say: Today's case: ph. These two letters make the f sound, like in phone. We underline both letters. You will learn which words use ph by seeing them.

items.answer: d o l p_ h_ i n
p_ h_ o n i c s
a l p_ h_ a b e t
t r o p_ h_ y
e l e p_ h_ a n t

activities.instruction: Listen to the f sound. Choose f or ph.

items.why: phone uses ph for the f sound: phone.
photo uses ph for the f sound: photo.
graph uses ph for the f sound: graph.
dolphin uses ph for the f sound: dolphin.
phonics uses ph for the f sound: phonics.
fish uses f for the f sound: fish.
fun uses f for the f sound: fun.
leaf uses f for the f sound: leaf.
fan uses f for the f sound: fan.
fast uses f for the f sound: fast.

example.say: Look at phone. The p and h make one sound, f. They are a digraph, so I underline both letters.
